current_behavior.description: Visual indicator of microphone input volume during recording

current_implementation.status: PLACEHOLDER - Not reading real microphone levels
current_implementation.limitation: Caps at 50% (0.5) based on recording duration, not actual audio input
current_implementation.reason: The AudioRecorder class doesn't implement get_current_level() method

display_location.visibility: Hidden by default, shown only during recording
display_location.layout: Horizontal, right side of duration counter

intended_purpose.user_feedback: Shows user that microphone is picking up audio
helps_with: Detecting if audio input is too quiet/loud

how_to_fix.description: To show real microphone levels instead of placeholder

required_changes.action: Add get_current_level() method to AudioRecorder class
required_changes.implementation: Calculate RMS or peak level from audio buffer

required_changes.note: Once recorder.get_current_level() exists, it will use real values

code_pattern.formula:
filled = int(level * total_blocks)
bar = '█' * filled + '░' * (total_blocks - filled)

customization.color_coding: Can add color based on level (green/yellow/red)

basic.python:
filled = int(audio_level * 10)
bar = '█' * filled + '░' * (10 - filled)
print(f'Level: {bar} {int(audio_level * 100)}%')
